scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend:e2e" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: cd backend && pip install -e ".[dev]" && cd ../frontend && npm install
